website.note: No dedicated R&D pipeline page; company emphasizes commercial portfolio

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Collegium Pharmaceutical is a commercial-stage specialty pharmaceutical company focused on responsible pain management and ADHD/CNS, operating entirely via in-licensing/acquisition of approved products. There are no active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 development programs in the public registry. The most recent late-stage trial (NCT06431256, HLD200/Jornay PM in 4-5 year old ADHD patients) was terminated. The 2026 acquisition of AZSTARYS from Corium added another approved product but no clinical-stage assets.

marketed_products: Jornay PM (methylphenidate HCl extended-release for ADHD)
